get.description:
Returns countries supported across live providers with flag URLs and supported subdivision codes. All filters are optional and can be combined freely; a request without filters returns every country served by a live provider. Currency and payment-method filters match countries where some live provider supports the value there (independent per-provider checks, not full route existence). When both `paymentMethod` and `paymentType` are provided, `paymentMethod` takes precedence. `headless=true` and `kycShared=true` must hold for the same partner as the other filters, for example `paymentMethod=APPLE_PAY&headless=true` lists countries with native Apple Pay. An unknown `country` returns `400`. Provider scope rules:
- No authentication: results come from the global dataset; `Meld-Account-Id` is ignored.
- Basic Auth only: results are restricted to the authenticated identity's `providers` claim. An identity without a `providers` claim, or with an empty one, is unrestricted.
- `Meld-Account-Id` only: ignored for anonymous callers.
- Both Basic Auth and `Meld-Account-Id`: results are restricted to the intersection of both provider sets. An account id this service has no account data for leaves the scope unchanged; a known account with no providers yields an empty scope.
- Naming an account that does not belong to the caller returns `403` when account-header enforcement is enabled, unless the caller has an authorized administrator or service role. With enforcement in monitor mode, the request is only reported and proceeds.
- Explicit partner filters are intersected with the resolved provider scope.

Explicit `partners` filtering is intersected with the resolved provider scope.
If the effective provider scope contains no providers, this collection endpoint returns `200` with an empty result.

get.description:
Returns per-provider field requirements and provider API path mappings for a payment method. Nested field `key` values are the leaf JSON property (`city`), not the catalog PK (`beneficiaryAddress.city`); nest them under `parentKey`. When `serviceProvider` is omitted, returns one block per category + payment method + country + accountHolderType, without `serviceProvider`. `providerValues` is returned only when `serviceProvider` is set and `includeProviderMappings` is true. During a rollout, `providerPath` is returned whenever `serviceProvider` is set, with or without `includeProviderMappings`; send `includeProviderMappings=true` if you rely on it, as it will become gated the same way. Without `serviceProvider` both are omitted. For fields with a Meld enum catalog, `allowedValues` holds the Meld values that the provider's codes map to, including codes already equal to catalog values. With mappings included, `providerValues` supplies provider write codes where translation is needed. Without `serviceProvider`, catalogued options are intersected across contributors; a provider that publishes no closed set does not narrow them. Fields without a Meld catalog retain provider-native options, such as bank or country lists. Aggregate responses include those options only when all contributors publish matching lists. An empty list means no value is accepted yet. Omission can mean no closed set or unavailable aggregate options; it does not prove unrestricted input. Fetch provider-scoped requirements for validation. A field is `required` if any matching provider requires it. The response is the account-facing contract for the requested category. Offramp keys with `derived=false` are what the account sends in payout details; onramp keys are the receiving-bank fields on the deposit instruction. `derived=true` means Meld supplies the value and the caller does not send it. The provider still requires it. Omit `accountHolderType` to return both the INDIVIDUAL and BUSINESS slices. All filters are optional and can be combined; providing no filters returns the union across all stored requirements. `countryCode` must be 2 characters and `serviceProvider` and `paymentMethod` at most 32 characters; violations return `400`. - No authentication: results come from the global dataset; `Meld-Account-Id` is ignored.

- `Meld-Account-Id` only: ignored for anonymous callers.
- Both Basic Auth and `Meld-Account-Id`: results are restricted to the intersection of both provider sets. An account id this service has no account data for leaves the scope unchanged; a known account with no providers yields an empty scope.
- Naming an account that does not belong to the caller returns `403` when account-header enforcement is enabled, unless the caller has an authorized administrator or service role. With enforcement in monitor mode, the request is only reported and proceeds.
- Explicit partner filters are intersected with the resolved provider scope.
